# Jubilees Chapter 20 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Abraham's Final Instructions to His Sons

---

**20:1** In the forty-second jubilee, in the first year of the seventh week, Abraham called Ishmael and his twelve sons, and Isaac and his two sons, and the six sons of Keturah and their sons.

**20:2** He commanded them to observe the way of the LORD — to practice righteousness, to love one another, and to act justly toward all people, walking in right judgment and righteousness throughout the earth.

**20:3** He commanded them to circumcise their sons according to the covenant he had made with them, and not to turn to the right or to the left from all the paths the LORD had commanded them.

**20:4** They were not to take wives from the daughters of Canaan, for the seed of Canaan would be rooted out of the land.

**20:5** He told them of the judgment of the giants and the judgment of the Sodomites — how they had been judged on account of their wickedness, and perished on account of their fornication, their impurity, and their mutual corruption.

**20:6** "Guard yourselves from all fornication and impurity, and from all the pollution of sin, lest you make our name a curse and your whole life a disgrace, and your sons perish by the sword, and you become accursed like Sodom, and all your remnant be cut off from under heaven."

**20:7** "For on account of fornication, impurity, and the corruption of idolatry, they were brought to ruin and became a reproach."

**20:8** "And now I make you swear by the great oath — for there is no greater oath — by the name that is glorious and honored and great and splendid and wonderful and mighty — that you will not fear any flesh, but will worship only the LORD your God, who created heaven and earth and all things.

**20:9** And that you will practice righteousness in all things, walk in uprightness, and not be led astray by impure spirits, for these seek to lead you astray before him."

**20:10** On that day Abraham divided all his possessions between Ishmael and Isaac. He gave the larger portion to his son Isaac, while Ishmael and his sons and the sons of Keturah received their portion from Abraham's hand.

**20:11** Abraham gave gifts to Ishmael and his sons and to the sons of Keturah, and sent them away from his son Isaac, that they might go to the land of the east.

**20:12** To his son Isaac he gave all his remaining possessions.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS throughout. "Fornication" retained as the standard technical term for zemmut — PNEUMA's "sexual immorality" is accurate but loses the precision. EMET's hyphenation retained only for "angel-of-the-presence" type compounds; here standard rendering preferred. See disagreement log.*
